name: wise
description: Wise MCP server for Claude and AI agents. 15 tools for balances, recipients, quotes and transfers on a Wise business account, with every payment set up unpaid for you to pay in Wise.
long_description:
Connects Claude to a Wise business account with a personal API token from wise.com/settings/api-tokens.

It sets payments up and never pays them: a transfer made here waits in Wise until you pay it in the Wise app or website. There is no tool that moves money.

Saving a recipient, setting up a payment and cancelling one each wait for your approval.

api_token.title: Wise API token
api_token.description: A personal API token from wise.com/settings/api-tokens (Your account > Connect and manage apps > API tokens).

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: live, or sandbox for a token from Wise's sandbox.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide every tool that can save a recipient, price, set up or cancel a payment.
